name: Titles And Names Of Saints
overview: Scripture reveals that saints are identified by their special relationship to God, often described as 'blessed of the LORD' and called to be a holy nation and a kingdom of priests, as shown in Genesis and Exodus. They are portrayed as God's treasured people—children of the LORD—who belong to Him and live under His covenant, emphasizing their unique status and calling. This divine identity highlights both privilege and responsibility, reflecting a spiritual heritage rooted in obedience and fellowship with God.
